# Curl metadata fixture

Unmodified files from `macports/macports-ports` commit `bb1307e0be60b6c717255ceedbb5a652e5795569`.

These BSD-licensed sources are test data; they are evaluated by the Rust engine,
never by a Tcl executable. The adjacent LICENSE applies to all four files.

The tests supply platform/build variables and cover metadata and selected variants.
They do not execute hooks, initialize the full PortSystem, or prove installation.
